name: rushing/laravel-package-topology
description: A declarative package-topology substrate for Laravel monorepos, riding rushing/laravel-graphine: one TopologyContract spanning two axes — the composer-require graph (direct edges, reachability, layering, cycles) and the source-import boundary (AST namespace guard) — plus a testing kit so a repo declares its architecture instead of hand-rolling fitness tests.

suggest.phpunit/phpunit: The testing kit (AssertsPackageTopology / PackageTopologyConformance) needs a PHPUnit-providing host.
suggest.nikic/php-parser: BSD-3 — the AST scanner behind graphine's SeamGuard, used by the source-import axis (sourceNeverReferences).
